text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's season—at a certain venue. A 
group of volunteer Umamusume had gathered 
to hold a Valentine's event.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Baking sweets to their hearts' content 
under lovely decorations, then eating 
together. Looking over the warm atmosphere 
of the venue—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was patrolling the venue together with 
Fenomeno.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss! Currently, all clear, sir!
choice_data_list:
Good work today. Everything's clear on 
this end too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely during fun events that one 
tends to let their guard down!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Breaking curfew, damaging the walls, and 
even bringing in DJ equipment to blast 
music all night long... There's no 
guarantee the chaos we've cracked down on 
in the past won't happen again!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I have full faith in everyone! However, 
there is no absolute certainty! Once an 
incident occurs, it's too late!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, on the day of the event, I 
intend to volunteer for patrol duty!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her story, I figured two would be 
better than one, so I decided to keep her 
company.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However... to have kept you company on 
such a cold night— I feel terribly 
apologetic for bringing this up so late.
choice_data_list: No, no, I do it because I want to— *achoo*

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Nothing out of the ordinary was 
found, so shall we switch to indoor 
patrol?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nodded and began to walk—and at that 
moment, something moved slowly in the 
bushes behind Fenomeno.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A person. Holding a 
rectangular—smartphone, aimed squarely at 
Fenomeno.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps noticing my gaze, the figure 
silently vanished into the depths of the 
forest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I should probably report this. But if it 
gets away first... there's no telling how 
it might be misused!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss!? Where are you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She probably wouldn't want to know she was 
photographed without permission. Skipping 
the detailed explanation, I left Fenomeno 
behind and gave chase.

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text:
*pant*! *gasp*! Argh... dammit! So 
annoying!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right after that, I caught sight of her. 
And then――I ran and ran, until I finally 
caught up within arm's reach.
choice_data_list:
Excuse me, may I have a moment of your 
time?!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text:
Please don't follow me, I'll report you 
for stalking!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And as if having given up on running 
away, it came toward me menacingly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She shoved my shoulder with great force 
and closed the distance, pressing in 
aggressively.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While backing away and trying to soothe 
him, I suddenly noticed... a smartphone 
strap peeking out from his jacket pocket.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And then, a shock rippled through me. 
My body flew sideways. My legs tangled, my 
hands grasped at empty airâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I had fallen into the 
pond.

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Woman
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! Jeez, what are you being 
chased by?!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text:
This guy's so persistent...! I'm gonna 
smack 'em one. Teach 'em a lesson.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A man heading straight this way. As I 
struggled to regain my footing—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ......Boss!? Why are you in the pond――

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!!! YOU BASTAAARD!!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Crap, an Umamusume! Run for it!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: DOOON'T RUUUN! STOOOOP RIGHT THEEEERE!!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the visage of a demon, she caught up 
to them and blocked their path. As the two 
slumped to the ground, Fenomeno reached 
for their collars—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Setting aside my own actions for a 
moment, I can't let anything happen to 
her. Besides—"
choice_data_list: It's okay... I can handle this, probably!
It's okay... I can handle it, probably!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shivering from the cold water, she raised 
her right hand— the hand clutching the 
smartphone she had swiped from the 
culprit, waving it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we went to the police station 
to hand over the smartphone, filed a 
report, and completed the various 
procedures.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to the police who inspected the 
smartphone, the perpetrator appeared to be 
a repeat offender, and other Umamusume had 
fallen victim as well.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —So then, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: W-W-WHAT ARE YOU DOOOIIING?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
All on your own! Without consulting me! 
Chasing after a voyeur!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"You fell into the pond! Your opponents 
were a pair! They were aggressive! If I 
hadn't arrived, you would have—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You...! Why, of all the people...!! 
Argh... you—you—!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: YOU FOOOOOOL!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, haa, haa... gh!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu... *sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, no!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
F-From now on, please make sure to consult 
me and seek my cooperation before taking 
action!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your concern, I really do! 
More importantly, though—! I'm completely 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's on me... I apologize for 
losing my composure.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, that's right! I bought this just a 
moment ago. I thought you might be feeling 
cold...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Here is some hot chocolate. Please, enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: No! ...Please don't burn yourself, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The paper cup handed to me was so hot my 
fingertips went numb.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After muttering that, Fenomeno held her 
head in her hands.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...? Ah, no! Not in that way! I was just 
sighing at myself, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Um... originally, I had intended to 
explain this in a slightly more logical 
manner.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"However, as I recall that scene... my 
chest aches so much—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Emotions are...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I beg of you, please promise me that you 
will not make the same mistake again.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's quite cold out, isn't it? You 
must be hungry too! Let's head back to the 
academy right away!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A bento, and... —maybe buy some chocolate 
cake, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sweet aroma catches my attention from 
somewhere. As she sets off in search of 
the cake shop, a single snowflake lands on 
her shoulder and melts away.
